fact: In a CTCN request signed in September 2020, Sudan's Ministry of Agriculture and Forests sought technical assistance to enhance the national agricultural monitoring system with earth observation, stating that Sudan has not fully developed EO-based monitoring systems because of technology and financial barriers.
title: Technical Assistance Response Plan – Terms of Reference: Developing Methodology and Capacity for Monitoring Climate Change and its Impacts on Agriculture in Sudan through Earth Observations (Request 2019000057)
publisher: Climate Technology Centre and Network (CTCN), for Sudan Ministry of Agriculture and Forests
